label: Lower coolant hose clip corrosion causing coolant leak
symptom: Coolant leaks from the front of the car, potentially leading to a complete loss of coolant.
cause: Plastic clip at the radiator connection corrodes and loosens, breaking the seal.
fix: Replace the OEM clip with a jubilee clip, tightened carefully to avoid damaging the plastic radiator neck.
inspection_advice: Inspect the lower radiator hose connection for corrosion or dampness.
